title: Iluka Resources
summary: Australian mineral-sands producer building a rare-earth refinery.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Iluka produces zircon and titanium dioxide feedstocks and is developing a rare-earth refinery in Western Australia to separate neodymium, praseodymium and heavier elements. The project would add non-Chinese separation capacity for magnet supply chains. Mineral-sands pricing and project delivery drive the stock.

Technology Exposure

  • Zircon and titanium feedstocks
  • Rare-earth separation project
  • Mineral sands mining

What To Watch

  • Rare-earth refinery construction
  • Mineral-sands pricing
  • Project funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
